name: Aalto

tierList.prydwen: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid role)

kit.intro: 4-star Aero Pistols. Playable as either a mid-air-attack Main DPS or a Hybrid buffer via Outro (23% Aero DMG Deepen to next character). Kit centers on 'Mist' zones and a 'Gate of Quandary' that empower attacks fired through them.

skills.normalAttack: Half Truths - up to 5 shots; Basic Attack 4 spreads a Mist zone.
skills.resonanceSkill: Shift Trick - casts Mist + a Mist Avatar clone that taunts enemies and generates Mist Bullets (Aero DMG).
skills.forte: Misty Cover - passing through Mist/Gate triggers 'Mistcloak Dash' (speed buff, consumes Mist Drops to generate extra Mist Missiles); max 6 Mist Drops.
skills.liberation: Flower in the Mist - generates a 'Gate of Quandary' (10s) that buffs ATK for bullets passing through it.
skills.outro: Dissolving Mist - next character (or nearby team on Outro) gains 23% Aero DMG Deepen for 14s or until swapped.

bestWeapons: Static Mist (100%, best for Hybrid role)
echoSet: Windward Pilgrimage (5pc, only with Ciaccona/Aero-Erosion team)

mainStats.cost3: Aero DMG; Aero DMG > Energy Regen

teams.name: Best Team (DPS)
teams.notes: Mono-Aero core with Ciaccona for Aero Erosion synergy and Windward Pilgrimage set.

teams.name: Best Team (Hybrid)
teams.notes: Outro-buffer slot, not optimal (outclassed by Mortefi for Jiyan) but usable filler.

rotation: Skill (Mist Avatar, weave into other character's rotation to reset cooldown) -> Intro -> Liberation -> Skill again -> Basic P1-P5 -> Echo -> Outro. Forte Circuit generally skipped in the fast Concerto-focused rotation.
communityNotes: Prydwen review: unique dual-role unit (DPS or Hybrid buffer) but outclassed in the Hybrid slot by Mortefi for Jiyan teams; viable but subpar Main DPS via mid-air pistol shots if fully invested. No strong current meta niche as of 3.2 review.
